replace:
+ 'pressing Space to get PAST this.',
    storage: MID_CAMPAIGN,
    /**
     * NO STORAGE, deliberately.
why: Seeds a mid-campaign save under the state that photographs a FIRST load. The picture would be identical -- the splash does not read the save -- so nothing visual would catch it, and the caption beside it would describe a returning player looking at a screen only a new one sees. The catalogue's captions are what a reviewer reads, so a state whose storage contradicts its description is worse than one with no storage at all.
killedBy: the screen-state catalogue keeps the two pre-UI states pre-UI, rather than merely undismissed
